basic_profile.bio: PixelGamer_21 is a university student based in Seattle, Washington, pursuing a degree in Computer Science. With a keen interest in cutting-edge technology and gaming, they often delve into the intricacies of display technologies and gaming hardware. They are an avid gamer, spending their evenings exploring new titles on their custom-built PC. When not engaged in technology, they enjoy cooking healthy meals and exploring new recipes. Their online presence is most active during late afternoons and evenings. Currently single, they are focused on their studies and personal development, often participating in online communities to expand their knowledge.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: PixelGamer_21 has a solid foundation in computer hardware and gaming technology, largely self-taught through online forums, tutorials, and hands-on experience with building and optimizing PCs. Their current academic pursuit in Computer Science further enhances their technical understanding.
